content.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
entries: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn. In addition, whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, double the number of hit points it restores.

content.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
entries: While wearing this pendant, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Life Preservation
entries: Whenever you make a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|SRD52}, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.

entries.name: Natural Healing Boost
entries: Whenever you roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52|Hit Point Die} to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, double the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} it restores.
